greeting.text: Excuse me, young one! Or are you a teacher? Can I ask the way?

lines.text: Where do I catch the No. 7 bus? The one to Haeoreum Stream.
They keep renaming the stops these days, it's confusing.
My grandkid lives around here. I came to drop off some side dishes.
Thank you. Young people are all so busy, I feel bad even asking.

flushRemark.text: Oh dear, did I keep you? Your face went red.

closers.parried: Oh, you're busy, go on, go on!
closers.endured: I talked a lot, didn't I? Thank you.
closers.sos: You've got a call, take it!
